    Shop Information

    These fields appear on your public vendor card. Use the shopfront photo, description, and campus location to help students recognise your stall when they browse vendors.

    Where is your shop?

    Pick the school you trade at. If it isn't listed, choose "Other" and type it in yourself.

    Institution type: -

    Opening hours

    Tick each day you're open and pick the hours. When the current time is outside these hours, customers will see your shop as closed and won't be able to order.

    Summary: Closed all week

    Uncheck this to immediately mark your shop as closed, even during your opening hours (for example if you've sold out or stepped away).

    This image is shown on your public vendor card. Photos under 5 MB work best. They are stored in Firebase Storage; the shop record only keeps the path and download URL.
